user.title: Set up Sous Chef
user.description: Sous Chef holds all your probes and ambient sensors. After it is set up, add each probe, each ambient sensor and any food of your own on its page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sous Chef is already set up. Add probes, ambient sensors and foods on its page.

user.title: Add a probe
user.description: Choose the probe that goes in the food. Only devices with a temperature sensor are listed.

data_description.device: Its temperature sensors are found on the device.
data_description.colors: The colored bands on the probe, in order. Choose several for a striped probe. The Sous Chef Card shows the probe in these colors.

data.auto_on: Turn on when it starts reporting

data_description.internal: The one sensor that stands for the inside of the food. Leave it empty to use the lowest of the channels.
data_description.channels: The probe's sensors, in order from the tip. The Sous Chef Card lists them in this order, and Max is the highest of them.
data_description.auto_on: Turn the probe on by itself when it starts reporting, such as when it comes off its charger. Leave this off for a probe that reports all the time.
